data.name: Eye Gouge
data.description: If you confirm a critical hit with his unarmed strike or begin your turn grappled, you may attempt a dirty trick maneuver to blind his target as a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. A target more than one size category larger is unaffected.
